a wind from a favorable quarter

A word not known elsewhere, which the scholiast explains: γονίας ἄνεμος [a favorable wind], when from calm weather a violent wind is stirred up. Hesychius: γονίας [favorable]: εὐχερής [easy, manageable]. In A. Agamemnon (an error of the grammarian for Choephori), to which Hermann's interpretation, a wind blowing with a favorable blast, fits.
